query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'caseId',r.case_id,'revision',r.revision, 'state',r.state::text,'reviewSnapshotId',r.review_snapshot_id, 'publicPayloadSha256',r.public_payload_sha256,'previewSha256',r.preview_sha256, 'publishedBy',r.published_by,'publishedAt',r.published_at, 'supersedesRevision',r.supersedes_revision,'reason',r.reason) FROM editorial.publication_revisions r WHERE r.id=$1
